title: Pradeep Kumar Biswas v. Indian Institute of Chemical Biology

content.caseIdentity: Pradeep Kumar Biswas v. Indian Institute of Chemical Biology, (2002) 5 SCC 111
content.holding: A 7-judge Bench overruled Sabhajit Tewary; held that CSIR is State because it is financially, functionally, and administratively dominated by the Government under pervasive control.
content.relevance: Modern benchmark test of financial, functional, and administrative domination.
